entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Given my circumstance, I expect the[n]others to be trapped here as well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then perhaps everyone else will be[n]in the same state I was...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Joker, I can sense no Shadows nearby.[n]I will remain on standby in this location.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I request that you go save the rest of our[n]teammates.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It would... likely be best if you did so[n]alone.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But you and I were both in this place.[n]I assume the same would apply to the[n]others.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are the others here as well?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In that case, I will remain here on[n]standby. I ask that you go save the[n]rest of our teammates.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I entrust the rest of our team to you.[n]I am quite certain they require your[n]assistance, Joker.
